title: Problems with installation
body:
<!--
Your issue may have already been reported. Please check the following link for common issues and solutions.

https://github.com/KillianLucas/open-interpreter/issues/164
-->

**Describe the bug**
I'm having trouble running any commands.

**To Reproduce**
After inputting my OpenAI key, when I give any command I get the following sort of error message:


**Screenshots**

NoneType: None
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.11/bin/interpreter", line 8, in <module>
    sys.exit(cli())
             ^^^^^
  File "/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.11/lib/python3.11/site-packages/interpreter/interpreter.py", line 131, in cli
    cli(self)
  File "/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.11/lib/python3.11/site-packages/interpreter/cli.py", line 207, in cli
    interpreter.chat()
  File "/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.11/lib/python3.11/site-packages/interpreter/interpreter.py", line 287, in chat
    self.respond()
  File "/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.11/lib/python3.11/site-packages/interpreter/interpreter.py", line 509, in respond
    raise Exception("")
Exception


**System (please complete the following information):**
 - OS: iOS
 - Python version: 3.11
 - Open Interpreter version (`pip show open-interpreter`): [e.g. 0.1.1] 

**Additional context**
Add any other context about the problem here.
